# temps_dns_provider_domain (Resource)

A zone a `temps_dns_provider` manages, so Temps creates certificate and hostname records in it.

Import with `<provider_id>/<domain>`.

Required API key permissions: `dns_providers:read`, `dns_providers:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_dns_provider_domain" "example" {
  provider_id = temps_dns_provider.cloudflare.id
  domain      = "example.com"
  auto_manage = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Zone apex, for example `example.com`.
- `provider_id` (Number) ID of the DNS provider.

### Optional

- `auto_manage` (Boolean) Create records for domains in the zone automatically.
- `generated_hostname_mode` (String) How generated hostnames are laid out in the zone.
- `proxied_by_default` (Boolean) Proxy new records through the provider (Cloudflare).
- `sync_generated_records` (Boolean) Create records for Temps-generated hostnames.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<provider_id>/<domain>`.
- `verification_error` (String) Why verification failed.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether Temps confirmed it can manage the zone.
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID at the DNS host.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <provider_id>/<domain>
terraform import temps_dns_provider_domain.example 1/example.com
```
